intro: Meet the NX Pro Digital Home Locker, the perfect fusion of style, security, and smart features. Thoughtfully designed, it safeguards your valuables with precision while making access effortless and intuitive.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism for personalised security
features.text: Enjoy peace of mind with a 4-6 digit customizable password, master key backup, and a shock-proof locking system that stands strong against intrusion attempts.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze for added safety
features.text: Protect your treasures from unauthorized access—after 4 incorrect attempts, the keypad automatically freezes, offering you an extra layer of security.

features.title: External USB charging support for uninterrupted access
features.text: Never let a low battery disrupt your safety. Convenient USB charging ensures your safe stays powered whenever you need it most.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override for peace of mind
features.text: With a reliable backup key, forgotten passwords or low batteries are never a worry—always ensuring you can access what matters most.

features.title: Built-in buzz alarm for tamper alerts
features.text: If someone tampers with your locker, the built-in alarm activates instantly, keeping your valuables protected and alerting you to unauthorized access.

features.title: Intelli-light sensor for seamless visibility
features.text: Brighten your safe experience with the Intelli-Light sensor that illuminates your valuables the moment you open the door, ensuring easy and clear visibility.

name: Nx Pro 8 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
